Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added a timeout for item listing requests that remain stuck loading with no returned listings. Items with no Market Board listings now advance to the next search result instead of leaving AutoBuy waiting indefinitely.
